Overview

Kansas City is a city in MO with a population of 509,319. BBQ capital with jazz history, fountains, and incredibly affordable Midwest living. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
